notes: A hand-checked catalog. Each entry says where it was confirmed (verified: official / third_party / unconfirmed) and when. Program owners change details without notice, so every card links to the official page. Deadlines are shown only when the source published one.

programs.name: NRC IRAP
programs.summary: Funding and an advisor for Canadian SMEs building technology products or services.
programs.amount: Covers part of eligible R&D costs, set project by project (recent calls: up to 80% of eligible staff salaries, 50% of contractor fees)
requirements: Incorporated, for-profit SME in Canada
500 or fewer employees
Innovative, technology-driven product or service
Talk to an Industrial Technology Advisor first

deadline.note: Not listed in the source; contact the NRC for current intake

programs.name: SR&ED tax incentive
programs.summary: Refundable tax credit on qualifying research and development spending.
programs.amount: 35% refundable credit for Canadian-controlled private corporations on spending up to the expenditure limit ($4.5M; a rise to $6M is proposed), 15% above it
requirements: Incorporated and paying Canadian corporate tax
Work that seeks technological advancement and resolves uncertainty
Claim filed with your corporate tax return

deadline.note: Claimed each year with the corporate tax return

programs.name: Ontario Innovation Tax Credit
programs.summary: Refundable Ontario credit on SR&ED spending done in Ontario.
programs.amount: 8% of qualifying Ontario SR&ED spending, on up to $3M (maximum credit $240,000)
requirements: Permanent establishment in Ontario
SR&ED carried out in Ontario
Eligible for the federal SR&ED credit and T661 filed
Limit shrinks once prior-year taxable income passes $500,000

deadline.note: File Schedule 566 with your T2 return

programs.name: CanExport SMEs
programs.summary: Matching funds for export marketing, trade shows, market research and IP in new markets.
programs.amount: $10,000 to $50,000 per project, up to 50% of eligible costs (project value $20,000 to $100,000)
requirements: 3 to 500 full-time employees
$300,000 to $100M annual revenue in Canada
Incorporated, LLP or co-operative with a CRA business number
Matching share paid in cash

deadline.note: 2026-27 guide does not list dates; check the program page for the current intake

programs.name: Canada Small Business Financing Program
programs.org: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
programs.summary: Government-backed loans from banks and credit unions for equipment, leaseholds and property.
programs.amount: Up to $1.15M in total (up to $1M term loans, $150,000 lines of credit)
requirements: Gross annual revenue of $10M or less
Start-ups and existing businesses qualify, farming excluded
You apply at your own bank or credit union, which decides
2% registration fee

deadline.note: Apply to a participating lender any time

programs.name: Futurpreneur startup loan and mentor
programs.summary: A startup loan plus up to two years of one-on-one mentoring for founders aged 18 to 39.
programs.amount: Up to $75,000 combined with BDC, per Futurpreneur's announcement
requirements: Aged 18 to 39 when you apply
Business plan and 24-month cash flow
Pre-startup or startup stage
You must take the loan to be matched with a mentor

deadline.note: Apply any time; the team replies within about 5 to 10 business days

programs.name: Futurpreneur startup program for newcomers
programs.summary: A smaller startup loan and mentor for young newcomers with little Canadian credit history.
programs.amount: Up to $25,000 ($12,500 from Futurpreneur and $12,500 from BDC)
requirements: Aged 18 to 39
In Canada fewer than 60 months
Citizen or permanent resident
Limited or no Canadian credit history
Two character references

deadline.note: Apply any time

programs.name: Black Entrepreneurship Loan Fund
programs.summary: Loans for Black-owned businesses at any stage, delivered through the Black Entrepreneurship Program.
requirements: At least 51% Black ownership
Sole proprietorship or for-profit business
Business plan, financial statements and 2 to 3 year projections
Not open to non-profits

deadline.note: Open continuously, no set deadline

programs.name: DMZ Black Innovation Programs
programs.summary: Programs for Black founders, starting with a 10-week Validator for testing an idea and demand.
requirements: Black-founded
Based in the Greater Toronto Area
Idea validation stage for the Validator

deadline.note: A listing shows 'Nov 20' without saying what it is; confirm on the page

programs.name: Indigenous Growth Fund (via Indigenous Financial Institutions)

Apply through your regional Indigenous Financial Institution, not to the fund directly

MVP or early traction

99 or fewer employees, team of two or more
Southern Ontario presence

Working product at readiness level 3 to 9
Automotive or mobility technology

programs.name: Mitacs Accelerate

About 6 to 8 weeks of peer review
